decisions.riario: Use the Riario shield. No Riario-Sforza branch or members are currently recorded.
decisions.livio: Both requested works depict the younger Livio Odescalchi. Neither is assigned to his grandfather.

mindaugas.note: Modern Lithuanian state arms used as a territorial reference, with a fourteenth-century origin explicitly distinguished from Mindaugas.

decisions.mrnjavcevic: The SVG design by Samhanin is explicitly based on the requested JPEG. Its 960px rendering replaces the low-resolution raster.
decisions.medinaSidonia: The crown group g20173 and collar group g9989 are removed from the supplied Commons design. Shield group g20316 is preserved. A lossless WebP is served; the adapted SVG is retained. Adapted vector source: scripts/assets/sources/v602-medina-sidonia.svg.
